title: Changing Packages within the Personal Services Plan
content:
A resident of the Personal Services Plan may change to another package, higher or lower, by signed request. The terms of a change are as follows.

## Terms

1. **Effective date.** The change takes effect on the first day of the next month when signed on or before the tier's change notice cutoff day of the current month, and on the first day of the month after next when signed later.
2. **One pending change.** Only one change may be pending at a time, and a later request replaces the pending one before it takes effect.
3. **Minimum commitment for a move down.** A change to a lower package, or to the Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan, may take effect only after the tier's minimum commitment months of the current package have run from its effective date; a change to a higher package may take effect at any time.
4. **Counting the commitment.** The commitment is counted in calendar months from the package's effective date, and a lower package may take effect on the first day of a month that is at least the minimum commitment months after that date. The effective date of the current package is read from the plan record.
5. **On the change date.** The new package's fee and hours apply from that month. Hours remaining under the old package expire at the end of the month before the change and roll over only where the old package allows.
6. **Assisted living residents.** A change may not move an assisted living resident into a package whose eligible residence categories exclude assisted living.
7. **Plan status.** Package changes may be requested only while the plan is active.

## Effective date by signing day (cutoff on the 20th for every tier)

| Signed on | Change takes effect |
|---|---|
| 1st to 20th of the month | First day of the next month |
| 21st to the last day of the month | First day of the month after next |

*Hypothetical:* signed on 20 March, a change takes effect on 1 April; signed on 21 March, on 1 May.

## Commitment boundary (3 calendar months on every package; 0 on the Pay-As-You-Go Plan)

For a hypothetical package that took effect on 1 February:

| Proposed effective date of a lower package | Calendar months from 1 February | May the lower package take effect? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 2 | No |
| 1 May | 3 | Yes — exactly the minimum, which satisfies it |
| 1 June | 4 | Yes |

A change to a higher package is not subject to this boundary.

## Points of judgement

- A plan that is suspended or cancellation pending is not active, so no change is requested on it.
- An assisted living resident on the Companion Package may move down or stay, but not up to the Comfort, Premier or Concierge Package.
